searchText: There's unfortunately no incentive to deposit early, so we're likely to see most of the deposits come in towards the end. Also, people could hold off on sending ETH even longer if they think the deposit contract won't reach the minimum validator threshold by min_genesis What happens if the threshold is never reached? ETH is just burned effectively? **vbuterin** realistically, it's possible the minimum just gets decreased and whoever did deposit benefits from a super-high interest rate until everyone else joins in What conditions would have that happen? 1 month, 3 month, half a year delay from deposits? Might be something worth discussing among the EF and Eth2 clients I wasn't sure how mutable genesis was at this point, if it is still mutable then the threshold just feels like a "nice to have target" rather than a hard requirement. The clients just need to update their config files To lower conditions for genesis block to generate I doubt it will be a problem tho 🙂 Is `EPOCHS_PER_SHARD_PERIOD` in the light client document the same as `LIGHT_CLIENT_COMMITTEE_PERIOD`? https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase1/light-client-sync.md I personally think, the toughest part of this sale, is the inability to withdraw without a clear tiemframe for that ability to become available it's something we all knew that's coming and agreed to but its really hard to sell that to people <@!273808422753796097> is there such a function in the contract to decrease the minimum needed ad-hoc? <@489217181104734219> Pretty sure that threshold is configured in the client as per specification <@!134118181710200833> oh! i guess that makes perfect sense, i don't know why in my mind it was a contract feature... I wouldnt worry about it, schone, I didn't know either is there a way to make absolutely dead certain the signature on my validators is valid *before* submitting ETH to the deposit contract? (ie that the --chain ID is correct) If you use the launchpad, it double checks before letting you use Portis/metamask/etc ah, does it tell me so, or just it would stop if it wasn't valid? It wont even let you go to the next page to select your wallet When you upload the deposit data JSON it'll give you an error message and make you try again
